name: Koumei Michiru
source:
She is an idol of the Three Nations. Her charm attracts the students of the Three Nations, but in her true nature, she is a schemer.

[From [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%A4%A7%E7%95%AA%E9%95%B7]Wikipedia[/url]]
